evidence_gaps: MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS: Fresh empirical data on net P&L after fees, slippage, and execution failures.
Lack of verified live metrics distinguishing between structural strategy loss and execution platform failure.

proposals.downside_risk: Delays potential profitable deployments, prioritizing capital preservation.

evidence.detail: strategy_lab_windows schema accurately tracks net_profit, fees, slippage_cost, and execution_failures.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents unwarranted live promotion while preserving shadow evaluation.
proposals.rationale: Without up-to-date runtime forensics providing empirical money-weighted net P&L after network-specific costs, no strategy can be verified as profitable or promoted. Continued shadow testing is required.
proposals.shadow_test: Monitor SHADOW strategies for >= 3 evaluation windows to empirically verify net positive P&L after all chain-specific execution costs and failures.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote recent well-performing SHADOW strategies to LIVE or CANARY.
rejected_ideas.reason: Missing runtime forensics means live profitability or canary-readiness cannot be reliably verified or claimed.

summary: Architecture-only review completed due to missing fresh runtime forensics. The codebase enforces strict separation of evaluation from live execution, explicitly distinguishing strategy/market losses from infrastructure/execution failures via detailed metrics (fees, slippage, execution_failures) in strategy_lab_windows.
